rationale: ROUND 4 on corr 7b0e2833. Round 3's gating objection (improvement_guardian, high: the producer now inserts at a claimable status, 'skipping triage-stage observe-only capability for this item_type entirely') is answered STRUCTURALLY, not by precedent: (1) THE ROUTER IS THE TRIAGE STAGE FOR THIS TYPE. Every finding's first contact is a deterministic, read-only classification against live DB state (the classify step writes nothing); FOUR of the eight routes act on nothing at all (they park the finding back at needs_human_review with the facts); two close only on positive evidence; and only two dispatch further work — into page-build-handler's own gates, which this trail MEASURED failing closed (the canary conversion was refused by validate_content and changed nothing). The triage function has not been skipped; it has moved from a fleet-global promoter into the type's own handler — and the fleet-global promoter this contract assumes is DISABLED (bugs_open/083; register IMP-016 'intentionally paused'), so born-detected today means born-stranded, which is the exact parked-forever state the owner ruled against on 2026-07-25 and again on 2026-08-15. (2) OBSERVE-ONLY CAPABILITY CONCRETELY EXISTS and was USED: the census SQL (workstream dir) classifies the entire population and writes nothing — it is the observe channel, runnable at any time by anyone, and this trail's own protocol was census -> per-arm canary -> fleet-hold. (3) The blast radius of a misfiring check is bounded three ways: the check's own 25-per-pass cap; the classifier's live-state re-verification (a wrong finding classifies as stale/resolved and closes on evidence); and the conversion arms' two-strike brake. If the seat maintains that detected-first is mandatory even while its promoter is disabled, that is a seat-versus-owner-ruling conflict, which per the estate's own norms needs a human, not a fourth resubmission — we state that openly rather than re-litigating. EVERY other round-3 objection is closed by measurement in this round: the asset_sourced scope question is answered by the PRODUCER'S OWN EMIT SET (check_required_fields_missing.go:198-223 keeps only source ''/llm/site_assets.* — site_specs./pages./query. fields NEVER enter missing_fields, pinned by TestMissingRequiredValueFields_SiteAssetsSourcedFieldsAreChecked — so the asset_sourced route covers the entire non-llm emit set by construction, not just the canary's instance); seed 410 is now LEDGER-RECORDED (schema_migrations row via run-migrations.sh --record-only, with an honest note that v1-v3 were hand-applied pre-record; the no-edit-after-record rule was never violated because the file was never recorded until now, and the recorded checksum is of v3 as applied); the single-active-row guarantee is confirmed LIVE by query (count=1); edit 3's status is clarified per editquality (COMMITTED and LIVE — documentation of fact, not a fresh diff); and RFC_030 now records round 3's reuse pressure with the deferral grounds and names 397's two routers as the engine's first consolidation targets.
